profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Currently, a L4 Software Engineer in Google Ads. Most of my recent experience is in Java and SQL.

positions.title: L4 Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: SQL · Bash · Java · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineering Resident
positions.description:
• Designed, built, and analyzed a data-driven scoring system for Google’s Cloud Streaming AR.
• Analyzed performance data in SQL to define scoring system parameters.
• Developed a C++ program to generate scoring system parameters.
• Graded streamed sessions in Python and C++, referencing the developed scoring system.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Saved Citrix money with a Costs Reporting System to show engineers the costs of AWS and Azure resource costs
• Deployed code to Citrix's Cloud Operations Website to display cloud resource costs
• Established database table and connection for cost storage using Hibernate
• Created a thread-safe caching system using HashMaps for quick cost retrieval
• Learned how to ensure code reliability by implementing Unit Tests with Mockito
• Active participant in planning and code review project meetings
• Fixed various UI bugs on the Cloud Operations website

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Backported Android Pie Real-Time Text feature to Zebra’s proprietary Android Oreo applications
• Investigated and troubleshot bugs by reproducing the issue, capturing, and observing log files using Android ADB
• Changed behavior of bug behavior to assess solution viability
• Provided daily Sanity Testing for Zebra’s Android devices for functionality with various SIM cards

Skills: Code Analysis, Software Tools, Cooperation, and Persistence

positions.title: Learning Resource Center ExSEL Tutor
positions.description:
Hosted small group tutoring sessions for UMass students in the Intro to Java course. 
• Strategy used for tutoring sessions included creating code examples from lecture to review and reinforce material 
• Helped students through difficult problems to further develop Java skills 
• Providing feedback and suggestions to Professor and Teacher Assistant on how to improve support for the course

Skills: Patience, Empathy, Verbal Communication, and Guidance

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
●	Debugged in Android ADB for Zebra’s Android Marshmallow OS and applications
●	Utilized JIRA to find, track, report, and discuss the issues on the OS platform
●	Filmed and edited instructional videos to show company clients how to install OS updates

Skills: Code Analysis, Software Tools, and Persistence

projects.title: Weather Box
projects.description: • Created a low-power, low-cost weather sensing suite that sends the data to a server and can be viewed on a map

organizations.name: UMass Amherst IEEE Student Chapter
organizations.description:
Chair						              Spring 2020
Vice-Chair						      Fall 2018 - Fall 2019
•	Plan and organize events for the ECE Student Body
•	Work with fellow officers to communicate with faculty and student body
•	Promote community for ECE Department and College of Engineering

Webmaster					           Fall 2017 – Spring 2018
•	Maintained the IEEE Student Chapter WordPress website using HTML and CSS
•	Volunteered at IEEE events, promoted the chapter’s and associating chapters’ technical events
